changes.comment: After a client reclaimed a daemon that exited without shutting down, `rush-client daemon status` now adds `The last daemon, rushd (PID <pid>), exited without shutting down; "rush-client daemon logs" may show why.` to its `No daemon is running` diagnostic, until a daemon becomes ready again or `rush-client daemon stop --force` resets the workspace. Before, the reclaim removed the ownership record that this report needs.
